ios.desc:
Turn outfits from Instagram, TikTok, and Pinterest into wearable looks you can try on instantly — styled for your body, your wardrobe, and your color palette.

Upload your mirror selfies or full-body pics — no perfect product shots needed. Aesty analyzes your style and builds outfits that actually feel like you.

You don't scroll for hours or follow trends you don't relate to. You build a wardrobe that's yours.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Screenshot an outfit from social media
2. Aesty scans the photo and identifies every garment
3. Try it on your personalized avatar
4. Mix and match with clothes in your closet
5. Shop only what's missing — with direct links

YOUR DIGITAL CLOSET

Upload your wardrobe and let Aesty work with what you own. Add items from your camera or photo library — the app automatically categorizes and color-matches everything.

- Organize by category: tops, bottoms, shoes, accessories
- Smart color detection and classification
- One-tap photo cleanup — backgrounds removed, items framed clean
- Wishlist for pieces you're planning to buy
- "Own items only" mode — outfits from your closet, nothing else

TRY ON ANY OUTFIT

See how any outfit fits your silhouette before you buy. Create a personalized avatar based on your body shape and try on looks from any photo — social media screenshots, marketplace items, or your own wardrobe combos.

AI OUTFIT GENERATION

Pick the occasion — date night, work, casual, travel — and get outfits pulled from your wardrobe and marketplace picks. Every suggestion is scored for color fit, style match, and wardrobe compatibility.

- Daily outfit suggestions tailored to you
- Build around a specific item you want to wear
- Discover brands that match your style

STYLE PLANNER

Lay out your week on a calendar. Drop in outfits for the days that matter — workdays, dates, trips — and let recurring picks fill the rest. The visual moodboard editor lets you build looks from your closet, or upload a photo of an outfit and Aesty fills the board with the matching pieces from your own wardrobe.

- Day-by-day planner with a swipeable week view
- Save recurring outfits (workdays, gym, going out)
- Moodboard editor with drag-and-drop items
- Snap a photo → matched items from your closet, auto-placed

FIND & SHOP THE LOOK

Send any outfit photo to Aesty's chat and it identifies every piece with pictures and shoppable links. No more "where did you get that?" — just screenshot, scan, and shop.

quotes.text:
Hi HN community,  
I’m excited to introduce Aesty, our new app that helps you style your outfit by full body photo.

What it does:    
1. Score Your Outfits: Get instant scores for your outfits to help you make better style choices.  
2. Personalized Advice: Receive feedback and suggestions based on your scores.

Why it’s cool: 
We all struggle with outfit planning. Aesty scores your outfits to give you clear, actionable feedback, making it easier to look your best.

Our journey: Launched yesterday, already 350+ users and 43 subscriptions & trials with a $0 marketing budget.

Looking for feedback: We’re live on the App Store and glad to hear your thoughts on our app especially scoring feature.

How you can help:   
1. Download Aesty from the App Store.  
2. Try the outfit scoring feature and let us know what you think.  
3. Share your feedback in the comments.

Thanks for your support!

Nadia, CEO

nadia@aesty.ai
